name: team_planning_settle_conflict
description: Settle a conflict an update to today carried forward in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: one team_planning_status reads as conflicting with a since. choice 'plan' keeps the planned change, set again in the scenario, pinned again with the same source when the scenario pinned it, or pinned there when it inherits the change (set again when the change's value is sealed, as a level is), with the change's own note unless given another. choice 'reality' sets what the Org Graph holds today in this scenario alone, a cleared level as no level and a missing allocation as unknown, so the scenario that made the change, and its other children, keep it; settled in the scenario that made the change, it reaches the children that inherit it. Either way status stops reporting the conflict, and team_planning_history marks the write with settles. Refused for a conflict no update carried forward (update the plan to today first), one status no longer reads as conflicting, following reality for a unit succession, or unless the caller is an editor. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
